title: What happens if the Sun disappears?

beats.text: What happens if the Sun disappears right now?
beats.label: SUNLIGHT

beats.text: For eight minutes, nothing. You don't even notice.
beats.label: TIME SINCE

beats.text: Then the sky goes black. Instantly.
beats.label: SUNLIGHT

beats.text: The Moon vanishes too. It was only ever reflecting the Sun.
beats.label: MOONLIGHT

beats.text: And Earth flies off in a straight line into the dark.
beats.label: ORBIT

beats.text: Your phone still works. For now.
beats.label: POWER GRID

beats.text: Solar farms die first. Then the panic buying starts.
beats.label: POWER GRID

beats.text: By the end of week one, the temperature drops below zero.
beats.label: SURFACE TEMP

beats.text: Plants stop making oxygen. Crops freeze in the fields.
beats.label: SURFACE TEMP

beats.text: Rule one. Get underground. Rock holds heat.
beats.label: DEPTH

beats.text: Up there, after one year, it's minus seventy-three.
beats.label: SURFACE TEMP

beats.text: The oceans freeze from the top down.
beats.label: ICE SHEET

beats.text: But under the ice, the water stays liquid for thousands of years.
beats.label: WATER TEMP

beats.text: Down there, volcanic vents still pump out heat.
beats.label: VENT HEAT

beats.text: And life that never needed the Sun keeps going.
beats.label: LIFE

beats.text: So the last living things on Earth won't be us.
beats.label: HUMANS LEFT

beats.text: Would you make it to year two?
